hero.heading: Honeymoon Suite
hero.tagline: Romance, privacy, and a soaking tub for two

overview.body1: The Honeymoon Suite is an intimate sanctuary designed for romance — a four-poster king bed, a freestanding soaking tub, and a private patio that opens to the tropical garden. Every detail has been considered for couples seeking a truly private retreat.
overview.body2: From the soft lighting to the curated amenities, the Honeymoon Suite offers an experience that is both luxurious and deeply personal — the perfect setting for a honeymoon, anniversary, or simply a romantic escape.
